tool_input.command:
sed -i 's/from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor/import multiprocessing as mp\nfrom concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor/; s/with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as ex:/with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers, mp_context=mp.get_context("fork")) as ex:/' salida/codigo/carga.py && time python3 -c "
import sys,os; sys.path.insert(0,'salida/codigo')
from carga import carga
viv,per,rutas,vl=carga(cache=os.environ['TMPDIR']+'/ccpv-rec-propio/cache.pkl')
print(viv.shape, per.shape, len(rutas))
print(viv.memory_usage(deep=True).sum()/1e9, per.memory_usage(deep=True).sum()/1e9)
" 2>&1 | tail -5
tool_input.description: Use fork context and load all files

tool_input.command: rm -rf "$TMPDIR/ccpv-rec-propio" && cd salida && find . -type f ! -name SELLO.txt | sort | xargs -d '\n' sha256sum > SELLO.txt && cat SELLO.txt
